    MORE REVIEWS

    📄 Editorial Review

    (3*) 🔧 Services: Web HostingDomain Registration
    HahuCloud is an Ethiopian web hosting and digital-services company founded in 2017 by Yared Ayalew, who continues to lead the business as founder and CEO. The company operates through HahuCloud Technologies PLC from Addis Ababa and focuses primarily on individuals, developers, organizations and businesses that need locally accessible hosting services and Ethiopian payment options.

    The name "Hahu" comes from ሀ and ሁ, the first two letters of the Ethiopian Ge’ez alphabet. This identity fits naturally with the company’s concentration on the Ethiopian market, especially through `.et` domain registration, local customer assistance and payments through Ethiopian banks and mobile-wallet services.

    The product range extends well beyond conventional shared hosting. Customers can purchase Linux shared hosting, managed WordPress hosting, unmanaged VPS servers, dedicated-CPU cloud instances, professional email, domains, SSL certificates, web design and related online-business services. An Ethiopian SMS gateway is also being developed for transactional messages, OTP delivery, scheduled campaigns, bulk messaging and API integrations.

    Linux shared hosting is the central service. Four packages cover personal sites, development projects, business websites and larger multi-site accounts. Storage ranges from 60 GB to 250 GB NVMe, with between 2 GB and 4 GB RAM, two to four CPU cores and support for three to fifteen hosted websites.

    Every shared package includes cPanel, a free SSL certificate, a free `.com` or `.et` domain, FTP and FTPS access, email hosting and CDN integration through Cloudflare. The storage allocations are generous compared with many entry-level hosting plans, particularly for customers running several websites or maintaining large media libraries.

    The shared environment supports PHP versions from 5.4 through 8.3, together with MySQL, PostgreSQL, Node.js and Python. MongoDB is not available on shared accounts, so projects requiring it need a VPS. Developers also receive terminal access, cron jobs, DNS management, phpMyAdmin, Softaculous and the standard cPanel file and database tools.

    Backup retention is another strong point. Standard, Professional and Enterprise accounts receive daily backups kept for 21 days. Enterprise Plus increases the frequency to six automated backups each day and retains recovery points for as long as 90 days. This is especially valuable for frequently updated websites, online stores and business applications where a single daily copy may not be sufficient.

    HahuPress Pro is the managed WordPress option. It includes 250 GB SSD storage, unlimited traffic, unlimited databases and mailboxes, a free `.com` domain, wildcard SSL, a global CDN, malware scanning, WordPress staging, SSH and WP-CLI access.

    HahuPress uses StackCP and a customized HahuPress management interface rather than cPanel. The platform is more streamlined for WordPress-only customers and provides direct access to staging, files, themes, plugins and security controls. DNS services for this environment use infrastructure associated with Google.

    The VPS hosting range is based on cloud infrastructure from DigitalOcean. VPS customers receive root SSH access, dedicated IPv4 or IPv6 addressing, SSD or NVMe storage and a choice of Linux distributions that includes Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS and Fedora. Resources can be increased as traffic, memory requirements or processing demands grow.

    The lower-priced Personal VPS packages are restricted to non-commercial use. Companies and commercial projects must select the Enterprise VPS range. This distinction is important because enterprise pricing is considerably higher than personal pricing, even when the underlying server specifications are similar.

    VPS servers are unmanaged. Customers remain responsible for the operating system, software installation, server hardening, security updates, application configuration and troubleshooting. Standard automated backups are not included, although weekly backup service can be arranged as a paid option through support. These plans are consequently better suited to experienced administrators, developers or businesses with their own technical staff.

    Dedicated CPU Servers provide virtual cloud instances with dedicated processing resources. They are designed for applications that need more consistent CPU performance than a conventional shared-vCPU server. These are cloud instances rather than traditional physical bare-metal dedicated servers. Public configurations and fixed prices are not available, so specifications and quotations must be requested directly.

    Hahu Workspace combines professional email, collaboration and online storage under the customer’s own domain. The service uses CrossBox for email and collaboration, Nextcloud for file storage and SpamExperts for filtering unwanted or malicious messages.

    Entry Workspace packages include 30 GB for five email users and 100 GB for ten users. Larger configurations with 250 GB, 500 GB and 2 TB are also available for organizations requiring more storage or additional accounts.

    Domain services cover `.com`, `.net`, `.org`, `.info`, `.biz`, `.et` and other extensions. Customers can manage renewals, nameservers, DNS records, transfers and WHOIS information through the account dashboard. Domain privacy is available for extensions that support it, while `.et` registration gives Ethiopian organizations and local businesses a recognizable national identity.

    Free SSL is included with the hosting packages. Commercial certificates are also available for customers requiring separately issued single-domain, wildcard or multi-domain certificates from Comodo or Sectigo.

    The web-design service is intended for businesses that need a complete website rather than hosting alone. Work can include custom design, mobile-responsive layouts, SEO-ready structure, performance optimization, development, testing, deployment and ongoing maintenance.

    The website uses a modern responsive layout that works properly on current desktop and mobile screens. English is the principal language, and no complete Amharic or other localized website version exists. The customer portal supports pricing and billing in Ethiopian Birr and US dollars.

    💰 Price & Cost


    Shared hosting starts at ETB 6,500 per year. The entry package includes 60 GB NVMe storage, 2 GB RAM, two CPU cores, 500 GB monthly traffic and support for three websites.

    The Professional package costs ETB 7,400 annually, while Enterprise costs ETB 8,300 per year. Enterprise Plus costs ETB 9,800 annually and increases the allocation to 250 GB NVMe storage, 4 GB RAM, four CPU cores and fifteen websites. It also includes the more frequent backup schedule and retention of up to 90 days.

    HahuPress Pro costs ETB 6,400 per year. Considering its 250 GB storage allocation, staging environment, wildcard SSL, unlimited mailboxes, malware scanning and WordPress-specific tools, it offers strong value for customers who do not need cPanel.

    Personal VPS packages are billed every three months. The entry 1xCloud server costs ETB 5,400 per quarter, equivalent to ETB 1,800 per month, and includes 1 GB RAM, one vCPU, 25 GB SSD storage and 1 TB transfer. Larger configurations reach 4 GB RAM, two CPUs, 80 GB SSD storage and 4 TB transfer.

    Enterprise VPS packages start at ETB 9,522 for three months for a 1 GB server. Commercial customers must use these business plans rather than the less expensive Personal VPS range.

    Hahu Workspace begins at ETB 3,840 for three months for 30 GB storage and five users. The 100 GB package with ten users costs ETB 6,480 for three months.

    A `.et` domain costs approximately ETB 2,380 per year. PositiveSSL is priced at about $160 annually, a wildcard SSL certificate at $330 and a three-domain certificate at $230. SSL invoices are converted into Ethiopian Birr using the applicable bank selling rate.

    All displayed prices exclude 15% VAT, which is added to the final invoice.

    Payment methods include CBE Birr, Amole Wallet, Commercial Bank of Ethiopia, Bank of Abyssinia, Dashen Bank, United Bank of Ethiopia and Wegagen Bank. Hosting accounts are normally activated within approximately five to ten minutes after payment confirmation.

    A 30-day money-back guarantee applies to the initial purchase of shared hosting. It does not cover domain registration, identity protection, VPS servers, dedicated-compute services, SSL certificates after issuance or renewal payments.

    When a shared plan includes a free domain, the normal domain-registration cost is deducted from the refund. Approved refunds normally require between five and ten business days.

    Customers transferring an eligible cPanel account from another provider can receive free migration assistance, help with the domain transfer and an ETB 2,000 first-year discount. The promotion does not cover `.et` domain transfers.

    🏢 Data Center


    Shared hosting and HahuPress accounts operate from United Kingdom data centers. The infrastructure uses NVMe or SSD storage, account-level resource allocation, caching, CDN connectivity, brute-force protection and automated backup systems.

    The VPS and dedicated-CPU services use DigitalOcean cloud infrastructure. The exact DigitalOcean region assigned to an individual server is not specified before purchase, so customers with firm data-location, compliance or latency requirements should confirm the available location before ordering.

    Current nameserver and customer-hosting records include United Kingdom address space routed through Hydra Communications (hydracom.co.uk), AS25369, and Enix (enix.io), AS52148. These networks are consistent with the UK location used for the shared-hosting environment.

    The shared platform benefits from centralized server administration and automated backups. HahuPress adds WordPress staging, malware scanning and application-focused management. VPS customers receive isolated server resources and root access but remain responsible for their own operating-system security, applications and backup strategy.

    A 99.9% uptime guarantee appears in the account login area. The Terms of Service updated on April 5, 2026 provide a more limited contractual position and require a separately executed Service Level Agreement for a formal uptime commitment and associated remedies. Business customers running important applications should request that SLA in writing.

    A separate status service provides information about current platform availability and active incidents.

    ✍️ Customer Support


    HahuCloud combines Ethiopian customer service with ticket-based hosting support. Assistance is available through live chat, email, Telegram, telephone and the customer-account ticket system.

    Online assistance is available 24 hours a day. Telephone support follows regular business hours from Monday through Friday, between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Ethiopian time.

    The support team handles account activation, billing, domains, shared-hosting configuration, migrations and general service questions. Free website migration is included for customers moving compatible cPanel accounts from another provider, and the transfer can be completed with minimal interruption when the existing account is properly configured.

    The level of technical assistance depends on the product. Shared hosting and HahuPress include management of the underlying hosting platform. VPS servers are unmanaged, so operating-system administration, third-party software, server security and application troubleshooting remain the customer’s responsibility.

    Self-service assistance includes a knowledge base, hosting and domain guides, announcements, a blog, WHOIS lookup, DNS tools and server-status information.

    🔨 Control Panel


    Shared hosting uses cPanel. The control panel includes email-account management, webmail, file management, FTP, MySQL and PostgreSQL databases, phpMyAdmin, DNS-zone editing, cron jobs, SSL management, PHP selection and Softaculous application installation.

    Customers also receive browser-based terminal access and SSH without root privileges. This is useful for Composer, Git, framework commands and other development tasks that do not require server-wide administrative access.

    Automated recovery points are managed through JetBackup 5 or an equivalent integrated backup interface. The number and age of available restore points depend on the selected hosting package.

    HahuPress Pro uses StackCP together with the HahuPress interface. It provides WordPress staging, file access, plugin and theme management, security controls, WP-CLI and SSH without requiring the broader cPanel environment.

    VPS customers manage their instances through root SSH access and the cloud provisioning system. A commercial cPanel, Plesk or other server-control-panel license is not included with the standard VPS price.

    Hahu Workspace uses CrossBox for email and collaboration, Nextcloud for file storage and SpamExperts for message filtering. Invoices, domains, renewals and service orders are managed through the main HahuCloud customer portal.

    🎯 Conclusion

    HahuCloud is one of the more complete locally focused hosting providers serving Ethiopia. Its strongest advantages are Ethiopian payment methods, local support, `.et` domain registration, substantial NVMe storage allowances, free domains, free SSL, CDN integration and useful backup retention.

    The shared plans are well suited to personal websites, developers, local organizations and small or medium businesses that want cPanel without dealing with foreign-card payments or overseas-only support.

    HahuPress Pro is particularly competitive for WordPress websites. The combination of 250 GB storage, staging, WP-CLI, malware scanning, wildcard SSL and unlimited mailboxes makes it a practical alternative to both ordinary shared hosting and a self-managed VPS.
